highlights: Ranked #1 of ~198 Ko Lanta hotels on Booking.com (Guests' Choice) with a 9.7/10 score and #4 of 103 on TripAdvisor (4.8/5, 3,600+ reviews) — consistently top-tier
Sprawling 100-acre hillside estate with 900m of private soft-sand beach on Kantiang Bay and huge Andaman-facing infinity pools
Exceptional, attentive staff repeatedly praised as kind, professional and anticipatory; free beach service with refreshments
World-class breakfast and strong dining spread — four restaurants incl. fine-dining Seven Seas, beachfront Rak Talay seafood, and Southern-Thai Spice & Rice

notes: Confirmed REAL and currently operating (2025-2026): official site pimalai.com is live with current promotions and bookings; it is a member of Small Luxury Hotels of the World. Located on Kantiang Bay in the far south-west of Koh Lanta, Krabi — flagship 5-star, 121 rooms/villas across a ~100-acre hillside forest estate with 900m private beach. Getting there (Lanta-specific): reach Koh Lanta by car ferry/bridge and minivan from Krabi/airport, or use the resort's own ~45-50 min private speedboat transfer from a mainland pier (weather-dependent). The remote location means a scooter or taxi is needed to explore other beaches/Old Town. Reviews mention minor jellyfish 'tingles' at times and the usual seasonal low-season quiet (green season roughly May 1-Oct 31, when Lanta is generally quieter and some services scale back) — the resort itself operates year-round. Scores verified: Booking.com 9.7/10 (889 verified reviews, #1 Guests' Choice in Ko Lanta), Trip.com 9.7/10 (242 reviews), TripAdvisor 4.8/5 ranked #4 of 103. Adults-only 18+ policy creates a calm, romantic, grown-up atmosphere - a favourite for couples, honeymoons and anniversaries
Two ocean-view pools plus a dedicated Wellness Pool, set directly on Long Beach (Phra Ae) with direct beachfront access and famous Andaman sunsets
Award-winning Linger Longer Spa with a strong wellness / yoga programme
Spacious, well-designed rooms, suites and villas (only 57 units) scattered through lush tropical gardens a few steps from the sand
Strong dining and generous breakfast - SeaSky beachfront restaurant plus Sundowners bar; caters to vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free diets
Ranked #2 of 103 hotels on Koh Lanta on TripAdvisor (4.9/5 from ~2,600 reviews) and rated 'Exceptional/Superb' on booking aggregators
cons: Genuinely expensive - one of the priciest resorts on Koh Lanta, and in-house dining is costly (guests note eating out is much cheaper)
Limited pool and beach daybed / lounge seating; sunbeds and daybeds fill up early in the morning
Compact footprint - the resort feels intimate/small, and a few reviewers describe some garden-category rooms as slightly dated or lacking a private garden

Long Beach is quiet/residential - you need a scooter, taxi or the resort's transport to reach Lanta Old Town, restaurants and the wilder southern beaches; typical Andaman low-tide shallows and occasional seasonal jellyfish affect swimming
notes:
VERIFIED real, currently-operating 5-star resort. Confirmed via official site (layanaresort.com), TripAdvisor (#2 of 103 Ko Lanta hotels, 4.9/5, ~2,584 reviews), Booking.com (listing live, 606+ verified reviews, SHA Extra Plus), Agoda (adults-only listing live), Trip.com (detail 710082, 2026 prices live), Kayak and Priceline. SCORES: Booking.com and Agoda exact live figures could not be scraped directly (both blocked automated fetch / returned bot pages), so scoreBooking 9.2 and scoreAgoda 9.1 are best-estimate approximations consistent with the aggregator data I did see - Kayak 9.6 (1,018 reviews), HotelsCombined 9.6 (917 reviews), Priceline 9.7 'Exceptional'. scoreTrip 4.7/5 is an estimate aligned with those; verify all three against the live listings before publishing.

PRICE: realistic cheapest low/green-season standard (Deluxe Pavilion) ~6,000-6,500 THB/night. Kayak showed low-season deals from ~$107 (~3,800 THB, deluxe) but high-season Deluxe Pavilion runs far higher; Booking.com peak was quoted 'from $311'. La Maison (top villa) exceeds $1,000/night (~35,000 THB). Room THB figures are approximate low/shoulder-season indicative rates.

GETTING THERE (Lanta-specific): ~25 min by resort/speedboat transfer or ~45 min by minivan from Krabi. Koh Lanta Yai is now reachable entirely by road via the Siri Lanta / Lanta bridges (mainland -> Koh Lanta Noi -> Koh Lanta Yai), so the old vehicle ferries are largely bypassed; most guests arrive by private minivan transfer from Krabi airport/town. On the resort's own flat beachfront plot (NOT a steep hillside property).

SEASONAL: no forced seasonal closure was flagged in current reviews and 2026 dates are bookable, so openNow=true. Note honestly that Koh Lanta's west-coast resorts commonly reduce operations or close in the green/low season (roughly May-October, monsoon) - confirm exact operating dates with the resort for green-season stays. Andaman low tide and occasional box-jellyfish season can affect swimming; the pools are the reliable option at low tide.

One of the island's original large family resorts: 99–100+ air-con bungalows/apartments on ~100m of beachfront with big pool + kids pool + waterslide, tennis court, playground, gym, two restaurants (Ruen Thai + a beach/pool restaurant). 3-star. Scores: Booking.com 8.5 (144 verified reviews); TripAdvisor 4.0/5 (443 reviews, ranked ~#25 of 103 Ko Lanta hotels); HotelsCombined aggregate 8.6/10 (1,136 reviews) — used as the Agoda-side figure since Agoda's own numeric score wasn't directly readable (anti-bot blocked), so treat 8.6 as an aggregate, verify on Agoda before publishing. Klong Dao is a shallow, gently sloping swimming beach; standard Andaman low-tide walk-outs apply but no notable steep-hillside-room issue here (flat garden layout).

GETTING THERE (Lanta-specific): reach Ko Lanta by car ferry or the two bridges from the Krabi mainland (via Ko Lanta Noi), then it's a ~30 min drive SOUTH of Saladan down the coastal road, ending on a narrow winding road to Klong Jark beach. TYPE/RATING: classified ~2-star budget beachfront bungalows; rustic wooden/basic bungalows with AC, fan options, private bathrooms, balconies, free WiFi. Roughly 6 bungalows total plus beach chalets.
